description: TPER - Fermate autobus is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna - Settore mobilità sostenibile e Infrastrutture. Dati sulle fermate T-Per nel territorio del Comune di Bologna e extra-urbane Rielaborazione dal Sito dei Servizi Web di TPer SPA (vedi reference). Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Trasporti. Its keywords are infrastrutture, Mobilità persone e merci, TPER, Città in 15 minuti. The portal shows 21,177 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
